name: dsh-session-move
description: Rename sessions, move them between workspaces, or delete them — from the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI sidebar menu. AI rename rewrites a session's existing title from what you said in it; move relocates the log directory, header cwd, workspace accounting and projection cache together; delete snapshots first and then removes everything. Every change is a snapshot-backed transaction with an operation journal and four verified invariants. Also exposes three agent tools: workbench_session_move, workbench_session_delete, workbench_session_rename_ai.

scripts.test: node tools/test-core.mjs && node tools/test-ops.mjs && node tools/test-move.mjs && node tools/test-snapshot.mjs
